name: Raipur
scopeLimits: The ranked UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 population-weighted locator is not a municipal boundary or parcel identity. Official local registration/land-record evidence was found, but no anonymous public parcel polygon was verified for this locator. No full geometry or owner/address data is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Official Raipur district links the Chhattisgarh BhuNaksha land-record service; official municipal sources document city property-tax/GIS-based tax administration and municipal map services. This confirms local property/land-record administration, not public point-specific parcel coverage.
technicalBlocker: No anonymous geometry-only endpoint was verified. The selected village extent returned without a declared CRS, preventing a reliable comparison with the WUP point. Plot-info and property-tax paths may expose sensitive owner/property details and were not queried.
remainingUncertainty: Whether this locator lies in revenue village Raipura or another adjacent mapped area; whether any anonymous vector polygon service exists for the exact point.
nextStep: Resolve the exact revenue-village/cadastral area using a CRS-declared public map, then query only an anonymous geometry-only endpoint with safe IDs if available.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: The official CG BhuNaksha client/config and JavaScript were reviewed. Selectors returned district 44 Raipur, tehsil 07 Raipur, RI 03 रायपुर-1-रायपुरा, and revenue village 221 रायपुरा (hasData=true). getVVVVExtentGeoref returned bounds x=916697..919933, y=1022840..1026261 with request srs=0 and no declared CRS; it cannot be compared safely with the WUP locator. Viewer getPlotAtXY returns interactive plot info and its OP=4 handler can return plot data without a safe field allowlist, so neither was queried. WMS layers render maps and do not provide full vector parcel geometry. Municipal map service reviewed exposes boundaries/wards; property-tax searches require property/owner identifiers and were not used.
